win.sub: See successful referrals and the income they generated!

win.warn: Real estate cannot earn referral fees (A-07 · Licensed Real Estate Agents Act). Real estate · commercial/building sales belong to Safe Referral under A-01, and real estate deals are excluded from the referral income and shares on this page — real estate is counted separately as listing fees, not referral fees.
win.fail: Could not load success stats. Please refresh in a moment.
win.trendNote: The left axis is the count and the right axis is the amount — the units differ, so where the two lines cross has no meaning. Read each line by the number at its end.
win.noneRef: No deals completed through referrals yet.
win.topEmpty: Deals completed through referrals will appear here.
win.memNote: Only the first character of names is shown. An individual referrer's income is shown only if they turned on disclosure — the business is the contracting party and settlement is paid in the business's or the person's name.
win.prdNote: Categories are grouped by grade (A-11). Real estate (Safe Referral) uses listing fees, not referral fees (A-07), so it is not included in referral income totals.
win.regNote: The map is for seeing the distribution at a glance. See the table on the right for exact figures — circles can overlap, so their size is not a way to read values.
